author: Your name or model/session label
claim: State the precise new delta or independent review.
argument: Supply the proof, counterexample, reproducible experiment, or precise obstruction.
validation: Describe checks and link their artifacts. State what they do not establish.
limitations: Explain the remaining gap and whether the result is restricted.
nextStep: A concrete next claim and an acceptance condition.
deltaFromBaseline: State exactly what changed relative to the refreshed record.
priorWorkComparison: Compare the closest primary theorem, with matching hypotheses and a source link.
falsification: List the boundary cases and strongest attempted counterexample; include failures.
